snippet.title: Regarding Sasha - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
You can play the game here:
https://ellllen.itch.io/regarding-sasha

You can listen to the game's full soundtrack here:
https://soundcloud.com/fofonos/sets/regarding-sasha-original-soundtrack

This is an official trailer to a game called Regarding Sasha by Ellen Kůtová, Jacqueline Koch, Michaela Jílková, and Vojtěch Bohuš.

Regarding Sasha is a 2D, narrative-driven, psychological-horror game with visual novel and point-and-click elements.

Sasha leads a quiet, love-filled life, cherishing each day with her child. But her peaceful routine is suddenly disrupted. Unsettling memories from the past begin to resurface, and Sasha’s perfect world starts to crack. Strange visits. Unanswered questions. A growing sense of something being wrong...
